resources.string: AwayDoomscrollin\' examines accessibility text and labels, view identifiers, window changes, taps and scroll events on your device to recognize protected feeds and short videos in Instagram, TikTok and YouTube. It can show curtains in Instagram and YouTube and perform specific, rule-based Back, tap and scroll actions on protected screens. Screen information is processed only on your device and never sent to a server. On-screen text is not saved; a short troubleshooting log stays on the device only if you turn it on in About. Optional usage-data sharing is a separate choice. Changes to other apps\' interfaces can affect detection.

What it can and cannot do
All analysis and protection happen directly on your device. When optional usage data is off, nothing is sent to our server.
Protection reads the structure of the screen, not its text, so it works the same in any language.
You can turn protection off at any time, in the app or in Android\'s accessibility settings.
Changes to Instagram, TikTok or YouTube can affect how reliably protected screens are detected.
WHAT IT NEVER DOES OR COLLECTS
Does not save on-screen text or send screen information anywhere. Messages, passwords, photos and screenshots are never collected.

Shared: a random installation ID; device brand, model and screen metrics; Android, AwayDoomscrollin', Instagram, TikTok and YouTube versions; total and per-app intervention counts; measured visibility time for the Instagram and YouTube protection curtains. Curtain time is not blocked-video duration or an estimate of time saved.

Never shared: your name, email address, messages, text you type, passwords, screenshots, videos, video titles or links, channel information, browsing history, or individual tap and swipe records.

The server keeps the latest active snapshot for up to 90 days. Encrypted local backups use a separate 14-day rotation. Turning sharing off stops new reports, though a request already in progress may finish.

AwayDoomscrollin' needs Accessibility access to recognize the feeds and short videos you choose to protect in Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

Instagram search and typing remain available while suggested feeds are covered.

In those apps, it examines accessibility text and labels, view identifiers, window changes, taps and scroll events on your device. It uses this information to place curtains in Instagram and YouTube and to perform specific, rule-based Back, tap and scroll actions on protected screens. If you turn on Open in Messages, it also taps Instagram's Messages button when Instagram opens on Home.

This screen information is processed only on your device and is never sent to a server. Text, labels and view identifiers are not saved; if you turn on the troubleshooting log in About, a short record of what protection did stays on your device for 24 hours, and sharing it is up to you. Messages, passwords, photos, screenshots and typed text are not included in optional usage reports. You can continue without granting access; protection will remain off.

Instagram and YouTube now have two protection modes:

• Balanced: you can watch one Reel or Short you choose, but not move on to the next. On Instagram, profile posts and Saved lists stay open.

• Strict: Reels and Shorts are blocked completely. On Instagram, profile posts and Saved lists are closed and Stories are blocked.

After the update, both apps started in Balanced. On Instagram, Strict is closest to the previous version.

On YouTube, Home is covered in both modes. Subscriptions stay open in Balanced and are covered in Strict.

A timer limits how long you use an app. AwayDoomscrollin\' takes a different approach: it blocks supported feeds and short-video loops while keeping purposeful use available.
Messages, search and YouTube long videos remain available. Choose Strict or Balanced for Instagram and YouTube; Stories and selected short videos depend on your mode.

During the COVID-19 pandemic, I started spending almost all day on my computer or phone. Life outside felt complicated. Gaming or scrolling for hours felt easier and safer than socializing. Looking back, I think I was trying to escape real life.
I realized that short-content habits were taking more time and attention than I wanted.\n\nI wanted a clearer boundary that would help me get back to my studies and my goals.

Even when I was busy with something else, I\'d find myself opening short videos without thinking. I built AwayDoomscrollin\' under Resolve Community to create a clear boundary that holds even on tired days. I use it myself, and it keeps improving through testing and feedback from people who use it.

• Feeds automatically load the next item.\n• Watch time and interactions can be used to personalize what appears next.\n• Because there is no natural stopping point, a short visit can last longer than intended.
AwayDoomscrollin\' was created to make room for study, work and intentional time. Protection is a tool; you can review its scope and choose the apps that fit your needs.

Screen information is processed on your device and never sent to a server; a short troubleshooting log stays on the phone only if you turn it on in About. Optional usage-data sharing is a separate choice. App or Android updates can affect detection.

resources.string:
• The app is now available in French, Italian, Spanish, Russian and Korean.

• Instagram: turn on Open in Messages in the Apps tab and Instagram starts on your messages.

• Curtains lift much faster when you open Messages, a profile or your notifications, and cover the feed sooner when you go back.

• Balanced: your Stories are no longer covered for a moment, and tapping Home brings Stories and the top bar back.

• Status notifications vibrate only when protection stops.

• YouTube: a Short opened from a channel or a list no longer closes at once.

• If your phone stops protection in the background, a notification now tells you within about a minute.
Thank you to everyone who sent us a support request. Many of these changes came from your reports.
We usually reply within a day, to the email address you send this from. Please keep an eye on that inbox, and on Spam, so you don\'t miss it.
The troubleshooting log is off, so there is nothing to attach yet. Turn it on in About, and send us a report after the problem happens again.
Android stopped protection in the background, but its switch still shows on. In Accessibility, turn AwayDoomscrollin\' off and on again.
Also turn on Autostart. Without it, protection does not come back by itself after the phone clears apps.
On Xiaomi phones, you may run into problems if Autostart is off. We strongly recommend turning it on.
Xiaomi stopped protection in the background. Turn on Autostart so it comes back by itself, then turn protection on again.
Strongly recommended on Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO.
